articles.title: Microsoft Confirms Windows November Updates Can Break SSO and Third-Party App Logins
articles.summary:
Microsoft has confirmed that the November 2026 Windows security updates can cause sign-in failures in some third-party apps and devices that use NTLM authentication. The issue can affect authentication proxies, single sign-on (SSO) tools, and application packaging products after teams install the November 10 security update or a later update that includes the same changes. articles.title: Critical Danfoss Refrigeration Controller Flaw Could Allow Remote Code Execution Without Authentication
articles.summary:
A critical flaw, CVE-2026-129713, affects Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA refrigeration controllers running version 5.4.0 or earlier and could allow unauthenticated remote code execution. The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) issued advisory ICSA-26-328-03 on November 24, 2026. It rated the flaw 9.8 out of 10 on the CVSS 3.1 severity scale.
